query:
insert into UsableNonLeafRequirements (
                agg_collect_nr,
                req_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                req_id
            )
            select distinct
                ur.agg_collect_nr,
                ur.req_collect_nr,
                ur.product_id,
                ur.req_id
            from UsableRequirements ur
            where ur.agg_collect_nr = $1

            except

            select distinct
                ur.agg_collect_nr,
                ur.req_collect_nr,
                ur.product_id,
                ur.req_id
            from UsableLeafRequirements ur
            where ur.agg_collect_nr = $1
